subject.title: [Feature]: Collapsible messages in Control UI chat

question: Should Control UI add inline collapse for long assistant Markdown, and what default threshold, latest-message behavior, and global-control policy should it use?
rationale: This is a new UX behavior, not a broken existing contract, and current code already has overlapping side-reader, JSON, tool-row, and duplicate-message disclosure patterns that need to stay coherent.

options.title: Approve bounded inline collapse
options.body: Implement per-message collapse for older long assistant replies, keep the active/latest response expanded, and defer global controls unless maintainers explicitly want them now.

options.title: Prefer existing side reader
options.body: Treat the current canvas/side-reader affordance as the supported long-message escape hatch and decline inline collapse for now.

options.title: Defer to broader chat UX
options.body: Keep this issue open but wait for a broader chat readability and accessibility design before adding another disclosure state.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded inline collapse
recommendation.body: Implement per-message collapse for older long assistant replies, keep the active/latest response expanded, and defer global controls unless maintainers explicitly want them now.
